text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday it would take a full year net extraordinary charge of 1.313 billion guilders.
Philips said that in addition to 725 million guilders restructuring costs, charged to income from operations, it had taken further extraordinary charges of 1.847 billion guilders.
"Of this amount, more than 600 million guilders is in respect of Grundig."
Philips said it had deconsolidated Grundig as of December 31, 1996 and had accounted for its 31.6 percent interest under unconsolidated companies.
But it said Grundig's results were consolidated for the whole year 1996.
